items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier and Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-01-18
items.q: The interviewee discusses playing 'Climax rag' (associated with Joplin) but does not mention meeting or interacting with Joplin personally.

ctx.x: Say, when you'll be playing a reg, say like, you know, Joplin's Sensation? Sensation? Sensation? I don't know. You remember the climax rag, George Lewis? Lyrite Theatre, you know the climax? How would you break them? How would you break them? Sensation. Sensation. You haven't played that here for many years, honey. Which one? Well, what's a rag builder rocking? Sensation. I don't know. You remember Climax rag, George Lewis.
Oh, Climax. How would you break that, say? Well, that's in the sea. That's like the mid-mammogacy. You just break...
